distance: median of 100 × absolute slope difference × shared resource span, across eligible periods

bootstrap.method: jobs are resampled with replacement within each configuration at each resource level (algorithm × level × configuration × period), so the set of configurations and levels stays fixed; deviations of a resampled configuration mean are scaled by sqrt(n/(n-1)) to offset the small number of repetitions, and a configuration with one job contributes no variation. This is not binomial shot resampling: it reflects job-to-job variation, which includes shot noise. Intervals are 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles

primary_outcome_rule: chance_corrected when either algorithm is in SHOR and the export provides it; otherwise success
